title.tc: 三個常見階段：可重疊，不是固定步驟
title.en: Three common stages: overlapping, not a fixed sequence

meaning.tc: 把犯罪現金放入金融體系。
meaning.en: Introduce criminal cash into the financial system.

meaning.tc: 用多層複雜交易掩藏來源、截斷審計線索及提供匿名性。
meaning.en: Use complex layers of transactions to disguise origin, obscure the audit trail and provide anonymity.

meaning.tc: 使犯罪財富重新出現為貌似合法的資產或業務收益。
meaning.en: Return criminal wealth as apparently legitimate assets or business proceeds.

note.tc: 三個階段是理解典型模式的工具，實際交易可同時涉及多個階段。匯款或兌換業務可能協助存放及分層，交易有商業外觀也不表示資金合法。
note.en: The stages explain typical patterns; actual transactions can overlap them. Remittance and exchange can facilitate placement and layering, and a commercial appearance does not establish legitimacy.

items.en: Assess statutory disclosure / consent and defence conditions; filing is not automatic permission to deal.

items.tc: 應立即檢視客戶／關係風險及適當措施；不能只等待JFIU回覆。
items.en: Should immediately review customer / relationship risk and appropriate measures; do not merely wait for JFIU.

items.tc: 防止通風報訊；繼續監察，新可疑活動再交MLRO判斷是否另報。
items.en: Prevent tipping off; keep monitoring and refer new suspicious activity to the MLRO for further-report decisions.

note.tc: 這三項是職責分類，不代表每案的措施完全相同；法定抗辯的「事前披露＋同意」或「事後自發且盡快披露」條件見正文。
note.en: These are responsibility categories, not identical actions in every case. The statutory defence alternatives—prior disclosure + consent, or own-initiative disclosure as soon as reasonable afterwards—are explained below.

title.tc: 內部報告：不經無關管理層篩選
title.en: Internal reporting: no unrelated management filter

refs.anchor: under no circumstances should reports raised by staff be filtered out

note.tc: 按程序直接交MLRO；非報告／合規管理層不得把報告篩掉。內部報告應載事實及懷疑理由。
note.en: Report directly under the procedure; non-reporting / non-compliance management must not filter it out. Include facts and grounds.

note.tc: 考慮合理可得的相關CDD、交易及其他資料；不能無限期等齊所有資料。
note.en: Consider reasonably available relevant CDD, transaction and other information; do not wait indefinitely for everything.

note.tc: 不是收到每份內部報告都自動向JFIU提交STR；其後新事實可能要求重新評估。
note.en: Not every internal report automatically becomes an STR to JFIU; new facts may require reassessment.
